chapters.title: The scaling problem and customer demand
Learning while doing in the product

features.name: Customer self-service onboarding
features.description: Vision for any customer to find, explore, and start using Business Central plus add-on apps by themselves, with digital guidance rather than hands-on partner involvement.
caveats: does not mean 100% proficiency without assistance
does not mean without partner involvement

features.name: Template-based setup approach
features.description: Onboarding philosophy to template as much as possible and let users self-serve and self-finalize the rest of the experience, reducing manual partner involvement.

features.name: Partner-knowledge apps for AppSource
features.description: Guidance for partners to package their consultant knowledge, domain expertise, and repeatable work into digital guidance and onboarding apps for AppSource.

features.name: In-product learning and intuitive guidance
features.description: Feature allowing users to learn while doing inside the product by understanding what features do, why pages exist, and what the next logical step is.
caveats: complex scenarios still require consultant guidance

features.name: Partner and solution matching
features.description: Matching prospects and customers with the right partners and right solutions from day one to ensure their first meeting with the product is excellent.
